(i) The informant-wife (Opposite Party No.2) had earlier filed Titilagarh P.S case No.211 of 2008 corresponding to G.R case No.479 of 2008 of the court of learned S.D.J.M., Titilagarh under Sections 325, 379, 380, 407, 420, 494, 506, 294, 34 of the I.P.C. and read with Section 3 (1)(x) SC and ST (PA) Act.

After completion of investigation, the police submitted final report in the said case stating that the informant has filed the case falsely in order to harass and humiliate her husband and in-laws intentionally at the instance of her advocate brother named Preetiman Nag.

(ii) Thereafter, the informant again lodged Titilagarh P.S Case No.22 of 2009 corresponding to G.R case No.49 of 2009 against the Petitioner and her in- laws under Sections 143, 341, 294, 298, 307,
506, 149 of the I.P.C. read with Section 3 (1)(x) of SC and ST (PA) Act.
The police after investigation submitted Final report stating that the allegations could not be proved, established or substantiated by any means and found to be completely false.

(iii) Thereafter, the informant again lodged Saintala P.S Case No.129 of 2010 corresponding to G.R Case No.503/30 of 2010/12 of the court of learned J.M.F.C., Saintala for the offences under Sections 420, 468, 474, 295-(A), 34 of the I.P.C. read with Section of the 3 (1)(x) SC and ST (PA) Act.
The police after investigation found the case to be false and

The informant has converted herself to the Christian religion and she has been baptized by following due religious customs at Ghunsar Pastorate, Diocese of Sambalpur (CNI).
But she falsely claims to be a member of schedule caste and she has obtained a false caste certificate to harass the petitioner and file false criminal cases against him.
The Petitioner has also filed a petition before the Tahasildar, Titilagarh for cancellation of her caste certificate annexing all the documents in e-cas-458/2015.
The marriage between the Petitioner and informant was solemnized on 19.05.1993 as per Christian religion and custom at Gunimunda CNI Church.

(v) The present informant had obtained a false Income certificate showing the petitioner as labourer and filing an affidavit to the effect that she had no income of her own for which Titilagarh P.S Case No.19 of 2016 has been registered against her under Section 419, 420, 468, 471 of the I.P.C. which corresponds to G.R Case No.57 of 2016 pending in the court of learned S.D.J.M., Titilagarh.

The Petitioner's wife Fata Nag had filed CRLMC No.886 of 2016 for quashing of the aforesaid F.I.R.
before this Court.
This Court vide order dated 11.05.2016 dismissed the same, holding that the allegations in the F.I.R. do make out cognizable offences which need to be investigated into.

sentences.text: As per the F.I.R., the informant is the wife of the Petitioner.
On 31.03.2015 at about 9.30 am, the Petitioner entered into the house of the Petitioner and abused her in filthy language while casting aspersions on her caste.
The Petitioner threatened her by showing a knife and told that he wanted to bring home his second wife.
The Petitioner snatched away her gold chain and ran away from the spot when the brother and son of the informant intervened.
(viii) The police took up investigation and found most of the allegations alleged against the Petitioner to be false and fabricated.

The police has submitted Final Form on 06.10.2016 against the Petitioner i.e. C.S No.373 under Sections 294, 323, 354, 506 of the I.P.C. only and it has been categorically mentioned that the second marriage of the Petitioner could not be proved and there was no aspersion of Designation: Assistant Registrar-cum-Senior Secretary Reason: Authentication
Location: ORISSA HIGH COURT, CUTTACK Date: 15-Mar-2024 15:56:15

Therefore, it is mentioned that the offence under Section 448, 379, 494 of the I.P.C. and Section 3 (1)(x) of the SC and ST (PA)
Act are not applicable in this case.

(ix) Based on the said charge-sheet and other connected materials submitted by the I.O. took cognizance of the offences under Sections 294, 323, 354, 506 of the I.P.C. against the Petitioner vide order dated 26.10.2016.

Challenging the said impugned order, the Petitioner has filed this CRLREV.
II. SUBMISSIONS ON BEHALF OF THE PETITIONER:
3. Assailing the impugned order, learned counsel for the Petitioner earnestly made the following submissions in support of his contentions:
(i) The Petitioner is the husband and the O.P. No.2 is the wife.
The petitioner is a retired CRPF Jawan and the O.P. No.2 is working as a woman constable under Odisha Police and posted at Titlagarh in the district of Bolangir.
The petitioner is Christian by religion and the Opposite Party No.2 was baptize by following due religious customs at Ghunsar Pastorate, Diocese of Sambalpur.
Her baptism certificate has been seized by the police in connection with the present case which is also revealed from the contents of the charge sheet.
But, the Opposite Party No.2 falsely claims herself to be a member of schedule caste.

(ii) The present Opposite Party No.2 had filed Civil Suit No.50 of 2009 in the court of learned Civil Judge (Sr. Divn.), Titilagarh against the present Petitioner for declaration of her right and title Designation: Assistant Registrar-cum-Senior Secretary
Reason: Authentication Location: ORISSA HIGH COURT,

CUTTACK Date:
15-Mar-2024 15:56:15 over the suit property concerning a plot and a house standing thereon.
The said suit was dismissed.

(iii) The parties are in a litigating term in a divorce proceeding M.A.T Case No.01/01 of 2012-13 filed by the husband which has been dismissed.
Challenging the said judgment, appeal (MATA) filed before this Court is subjudice.
(iv) It is submitted that only to give criminal colour to a civil and matrimonial dispute, the Opposite Party No.2/wife has filed the criminal case.
The intention of the Opposite Party No.2 is attended with mala fide and actuated by ulterior motive in order to wreak vengeance against the present Petitioner.
The ingredients of the aforesaid offences are not attracted against the present Petitioner and it does not meet the strict standard of proof required to sustain a criminal accusation.

The Opposite Party No.2 being a woman constable and in connivance of her Advocate brother has filed this false case with concocted allegations only to harass the Petitioner which should be deprecated and discouraged.
The criminal proceeding against the Petitioner as well as the order of cognizance is bad in law and warrants interference by this Court.

III. SUBMISSIONS ON BEHALF OF THE OPPOSITE PARTY NO.1/STATE:
4.

In reply, learned counsel for the Opposite Party/ State does not dispute the aforesaid fact, but submits that after receipt of charge sheet, the Signature NotMagistrate Verified took cognizance and issued process against the Petitioner Digitally Signed Signed by: BHABAGRAHI JHANKAR
Designation: Assistant Registrar-cum-Senior Secretary Reason: Authentication Location: ORISSA HIGH COURT, CUTTACK Date: 15-Mar-2024 15:56:15 being found a prima facie case against him.
Therefore, he contends that there is no infirmity in the impugned order.

IV. COURT'S REASONING AND ANALYSIS:
5. It is not in dispute that the informant-wife had earlier filed cases against the Petitioner-husband which are as follows:
(i) Titilagarh P.S Case No.211 of 2008 corresponding to G.R case No.479 of 2008 of the court of learned S.D.J.M., Titilagarh under Sections 325, 379, 380/, 407, 420,
494, 506, 294, 34 of the I.P.C. and read with Section 3 (1)(x) SC and ST (PA) Act,
(ii) Titilagarh P.S Case No.22 of 2009 corresponding to G.R. case No.49 of 2009 against the Petitioner and the in-laws under Sections 143, 341, 294, 298, 307, 506,
149 of the I.P.C. read with Section-3 (1) (x) SC and ST (PA) Act,
(iii) Saintala P.S Case No.129 of 2010 corresponding to G.R. case No.503/30 of 2010/12 of the court of learned J.M.F.C., Saintala for the offences under Sections 420, 468, 474, 295-(A)/34 of the I.P.C.

sentences.text: However, the police after investigation found the aforesaid cases to be false and submitted final report.
6. The police took up investigation and found most of the allegations leveled against the Petitioner to be false and fabricated.

The police has submitted final form on 30.09.2016 against the Petitioner under Sections 294, 323, 354, 506 of the I.P.C. only and it has categorically been mentioned therein that the second marriage of the Petitioner Designation: Assistant Registrar-cum-Senior Secretary Reason: Authentication Location: ORISSA HIGH COURT, CUTTACK Date: 15-Mar-2024 15:56:15 could not be proved and there was no aspersion of caste and snatching of gold chain from the complainant and, therefore, the offences under Sections 448, 379, 494 of the I.P.C. and Section 3 (1)(x) SC and ST (PA) Act are not applicable in this case.
7.

It was submitted that the informant-wife being a woman constable and in connivance of her Advocate brother has filed the aforesaid false cases with concocted allegations only to harass the Petitioner.
Therefore, the order taking cognizance should be quashed and the present proceeding shall be discontinued.
8. It is also apparent from the order-sheet that this matter was listed on 5th February, 2024 for filing of written notes of submissions by the learned counsel for the Parties.

On 5th February, 2024,
nobody appeared for the Opposite Party No.2.
Again, this matter was posted to 15th February, 2024 for filing of written notes of submissions by the learned counsel for the Opposite Party No.2.

However, in spite of repeated call, nobody appeared for the Opposite Party No.2 on 15th February,
2024.
9.

The above-mentioned conduct of the Opposite Party No.2 shows that the Opposite Party No.2 is a recalcitrant litigant which has been substantiated the fact that she has filed the aforesaid criminal cases including the present case only to harass the Petitioner.

10. Considering the aforesaid facts and submissions made, especially the conduct of the Opposite Party No.2, it appear to this Court that the allegation of the prosecution is without any substance and the same is Signature Notactuated Verifiedwith malafide.

There shall also be bleak chance of conviction Digitally Signed Signed by: BHABAGRAHI JHANKAR Designation: Assistant Registrar-cum-Senior Secretary Reason: Authentication Location: ORISSA HIGH COURT,
CUTTACK Date: 15-Mar-2024 15:56:15 of the Petitioner/accused in the aforesaid proceeding and as such continuance of the prosecution shall be an abuse of the process of court.
11. In such view of the matter, this CRLREV is allowed.
The impugned order dated 26.10.2016 passed by the learned S.D.J.M., Titilagarh in G.R. Case No.163 of 2015 is set aside.

Consequently,
the prosecution against the Petitioner in G.R. Case No.163 of 2015 pending in the court of learned S.D.J.M., Titilagarh stands quashed.
The court concerned on receipt or production of the certified copy of this order, shall do well to drop the aforesaid proceeding against the Petitioner.
12. With the aforesaid order, this CRLREV stands disposed of.
